integratedBehavior: The repository-pinned Tauri 2, React 19, TypeScript 7, Node, pnpm, and Rust inputs produce a deterministic offline application bundle and locked native build with zero privileged main-window commands and a restrictive local CSP.

The React runtime progressively activates the approved title bar, project context, command search, navigation rail, and main workspace across all 32 routes; route selection rejects ambiguous encoding, traversal, separators, protocol-relative forms, and scheme-prefixed links.

Keyboard navigation recomputes visible unique routes, excludes nonlocal anchors, clears stale current-page semantics, and preserves native link activation for canonical local routes; Ctrl+K focuses project search.

Project selection uses a strict version-1 opaque removed-ID preference record, deterministic ordering, persist-before-hide removal, explicit unavailable-location locate/remove actions, an accessible empty state, and fail-closed open/create intents pending CAP-02 authority.

Malformed or unsupported preferences are preserved without rewrite while defaults and a recovery notice are shown; unavailable storage preserves visible state and reports an accessible error; default events and diagnostics exclude paths, research content, credentials, and external requests.

Renderer code contains only shell, route, session, local preference, and intent composition logic. Filesystem, process, credential, service, sidecar, and durable project lifecycle behavior remain behind later narrow ports.
